Separate published production generator/clock-support adapter/auditor/source seals and exact resolved requests
Prospective TRAIN qualification for the common commands AND material/support/hardware prior; current four material points do not qualify a continuum of hypotheses
Validated independent-state renderer/sensor alignment before image capture; no native-physics substitution

joint_distribution.factorization: p(H,C,M) p(theta_material) p(B|H) p(support,law|B,H) p(passive_force_nuisance) p(A|H,C,M,allowed_observed_history)
joint_distribution.H: Public rest mesh + ordered full rigid patches/origins + measured masses/full COM inertias/COM offsets/initial rotations, sampled or fixed BEFORE latent BC/material
joint_distribution.C: Public camera/sensor plan from independently keyed stream; identical across latent counterfactuals for fixed H/menu replicate
joint_distribution.M: Externally randomized common menu replicate, independent of truth; all action amplitudes/families/timing/costs shared across latent conditions
joint_distribution.support_prior_primary: Exactly normalized finite certified atlas from ConditionalPhysicalPrior with all2x9 public patch nodes; use SAME stipulated prior to generate truth, train amortization and run numerical inference. All BCs must retain nonzero feasible support.
joint_distribution.prior_coordinates: 12D intrinsic chart plus categorical counting measure with normalized inactive nuisances; never25D physical-space Lebesgue density
joint_distribution.prior_decode: New complete hardware/BC-mask/support-law forward adapter required; do not feed existing25D decode to new forward model

support_law.single_support_inactive_second_group: Retain fixed tensor capacity, private zero mask; no active-count feature
support_law.moving_direction: Latent tangent direction on sampled support face
support_law.law: Initial rest-compatible3s sine-squared translation; explicit analytic law/parameters, no unannounced interpolation

joint_distribution.rejection_prior_alternative: Different designed law; NO log_prob. Unknown Z_BC(H); within-BC fixed-H kernel ratios or genuine whole-prior proposals only. Do not mix atlas truth with rejection posterior or use kernel as BC Bayes factor.

known_public_query.inactive_fields: Always include fixed-shape zero pure torque/nodal force/body acceleration; zero command is K1 not missing channel
known_public_query.public_neural_inputs: Observed causal RGB-D/camera prefix, public reference/full hardware, actual known actuator programs and requested times only

common_action_menu.tier_scope: Any enabled tier must apply identically to ALL BC/material prior strata. No point-pin quartering or per-object truth clamp.
common_action_menu.basis: Three signed/permuted world axes from public menu RNG; two orthonormal couple directions from public handle separation only
common_action_menu.families: zero plus3 pulse +3 pull-hold +3 shear-oscillation +2 exact equal/opposite moving-origin couples
common_action_menu.force_waveforms: Existing3s envelopes, compiled once on120Hz midpoint grid, float32quantized then promotedfloat64; explicit world force vectors, zero supplied pure torques
common_action_menu.budget: One reset probe initially, cost1 for every menu action. Multiple-action sequential phase requires new prospective decision.
common_action_menu.evaluation_commands: Withheld known directions/amplitudes or family instances fixed before validation/test; same queries across latent strata, require their own operating-point coverage

clock_and_forward_contract.held_history_refinement: Do not resample/requantize waveform at solverHz. For solverHz multiple of120, repeat exact actuator interval values; integrated impulse/first moments preserve same held piecewise-constant program.
clock_and_forward_contract.solver_settings: Private numerical metadata; must not condition image inference. Common conservative global solver rate for a production checkpoint is preferred until a separately validated private adaptive solver exists.
clock_and_forward_contract.existing_interface_gap: HeldCommandQuery currently ties force and support endpoints to one time grid; cannot silently expand public input by latent-dependent solver rate or invent between-endpoint support interpolation.
clock_and_forward_contract.required_future_extension: Versioned two-clock adapter: public actuator120Hz query plus separate latent analytic support-law representation evaluated at private solver endpoints. Full forward hypothesis context receives the COMPLETE law; image conditioning never receives its truth or private step grid.
clock_and_forward_contract.why_unset: Choose after actual-force gate and fixed-held-program TRAIN temporal tests; declaring960 now would reuse a different quadrature experiment without proof.

production_failure_policy.physics: Preserve failed truth/action slot; no redraw, drop, amplitude clamp or class-specific rescheduling. Pause affected production admission and make new prospective globally shared design decision. Numerical failure is not a zero likelihood or normalized truncation certificate.
production_failure_policy.geometry: Sample H first, certify feasible atlas for each BC; abort invalid public context before dynamics, never remove a BC. Keep rejection conditioning and density exactly matched.
production_failure_policy.resources: No simulator or training authorized by this draft.

minimal_next_TRAIN_design.static_geometry_probe_completed: All4 existing TRAIN public H admit all4 BCs in normalized atlas; only geometry/prior check, no mechanics.
minimal_next_TRAIN_design.pilot_factorization: Reuse these4 public H as fixed contexts; cross4 BCs with3 shared material anchor tuples then all12 common actions;576 driven/reset conditions before refinement controls, only after a separately bounded plan/source/proof seal.
minimal_next_TRAIN_design.anchors: Use one global tuple table across every H/BC, e.g E1500/5000/20000Pa with rho625,nu.35,drag.60 in declared units; NEW prospective states, not already qualified by four-layout gate.
minimal_next_TRAIN_design.moving_zero: Additional matched zero-support-motion controls and accuracy/translation/reset tests as declared by new runner. Zero is already one action in menu but not independent numerical validation.
minimal_next_TRAIN_design.expansion: Only after pilot and continuous matching-prior TRAIN coverage checks; dataset size/splits/solver rates remain a separate prospective frozen decision.

evaluation_contract.splits: Split entire public-H/menu/latent-family groups before physics. Keep all sibling BC/material/action/reset branches together. IDs not neural inputs. All categorical actions/BCs supported in each split.
evaluation_contract.forecast: Observed prefix times0,.25,.5,.75,1s only; target1.05..3s, known future controlled commands allowed; future RGB/depth/masks unavailable. Gap-filling with later frames is separate.
evaluation_contract.reset_transfer: Predict held-out reset-force response from passive/selected-probe history and complete known query; label independent reset, not same-rollout future state.
evaluation_contract.calibration: Prior predictive checks/SBC on stipulated prior; predictive interval coverage/sharpness and proper scores by BC/material/action/noise strata, with uncertainty. Parameter marginals evaluated when meaningful, no forced point identification.
evaluation_contract.active: Same menu/hardware/budget/camera choices/costs for every baseline; log selection before opening only selected outcome. Same unknown material/support law across reset branches, passive forces replaced only if experiment explicitly says so. Marginalize nuisance rather than plug-in truth.
evaluation_contract.numerical_reference: Small TRAIN numerical posterior uses SAME normalized prior, complete forward context, known query and observation likelihood. Surrogate discrepancy and sensor noise separately calibrated; no doubled passive evidence.
evaluation_contract.primary_goal: Held-out deformation/observation predictive risk and reliable useful-action choice, even if several material/BC states remain observationally equivalent.

anti_oracle_guards: Counterfactual same-H/menu replicate public command/camera/schema hashes identical across ALL BC/material conditions before physics
No class-specific amplitude scaling, stopping, command family or clock; known commands cannot be recreated from hidden recipe
Fixed H2/S2/K1 capacities and group-key presence; masks/law/unknown force private
IDs/source metadata excluded; randomization namespaces have no BC/material-dependent keys
Private solver refinement exact-held-command equality and analytic support-law clocks verified independently
No outcome-dependent replacement/failure filtering; density/prior and all inactive nuisance factors preserved
Data loader explicit causal allowlist with future-frame deny test; reset and interpolation roles distinct
Prior generator/inference metadata fingerprints identical; unknown-normalizer cross-BC proposals rejected
Menu-only/metadata-only no-motion baselines reported, with source-based invariance tests primary; statistical near-chance results alone not proof
